environment.database: PGlite 0.5.11, embedded PostgreSQL in memory; all repository migrations applied; no networked database or pool

limitations: Small local smoke load with synthetic data. Not a scalability benchmark. No warm-up; registration excluded. All latency samples include failures. In-memory test database is discarded after this run. Embedded PostgreSQL serializes database operations; this does not test server pooling or multi-process lock contention.
